decisions.reason: The requested STEP files make the integrated KiCad project portable; they do not change the sensor-board fabrication and assembly export package.
Missing local 3D models do not change BOM contents, component specifications, or assembly part-number requirements.
Supplying local 3D model files does not alter the required JLCPCB order setup or ordering-assistance workflow.
The message concerns inaccessible CAD visualization assets, not component availability, selection, or cost.
The requested models are for USB1, Q3, and S1 and do not change the ESP32 module or breakout requirements.
The portable-project file request does not change addressable LED supply voltage, data drive, or level-shifting logic.
Component STEP files used by the PCB 3D viewer do not necessarily change enclosure geometry or any current enclosure requirement.
The request for three 3D model files does not affect DCDC1 voltage configuration or rail-regulation behavior.
The missing USB1, Q3, and S1 visualization models do not alter the e-paper backlight circuit specification.
CAD-model portability has no effect on copper-path continuity, current capacity, or stitching-via requirements.
The requested 3D assets do not change the SPS30 SEL connection or required I2C operating mode.
The integrated-board model-file request does not change the separate eight-LED board's count, model, package, or color format.
